I went to the Udom Suk branch to get my retainer adjusted, but the dentist said they couldn't adjust it because my teeth didn't fit the lock. I wasted money on a service that was unreasonable; the full price was 650 baht, but they charged 550 baht, which is completely unreasonable. More importantly, they didn't inform me in advance about the charge if they couldn't adjust it, even when I called before my appointment (this is what I really disliked). The branch called back to apologize and offered a discount if I got a new retainer from them, but I declined. Anyone considering using their services should think carefully. For me, one visit was enough.
